versions.content: DRAFT If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and requests for synchronized PNC shutdown are pending, then the CanNm module shall set for this message additionally the following data beneath the normal data within the call of CanNm_TriggerTransmit: - Set the PNSR bit in the CBV to 1 - Overwrite the PN information in the user data (af ter NM User Data has been fetched, if CanNmComUserDataSupport is enabled ) by setting bits that correspond to PNC IDs stored as pending request for a synchronized PNC shutdown to 1 and all other bits to 0."
